node.title: A=1 core-one componentwise norm localization
node.statement: On the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree sharp cap, every component omission and component intersection is confined to the unique middle-Hankel regular slope. At most one component has one omitted root. If b is total residual parameter degree, the dominant component has exact column deficit C_*=e-5b-1+D_* and every residual component has C_i=5e_i+D_i. Each component satisfies its own exact norm identity J_i R_i=P^r_i S_i and complementary factorization. The dominant norm residual has degree e-5b-1+D_* and splits on at least 14m+5b residual domain rows. Together with separation rank at least five, this is the exact remaining mixed norm object; it is not excluded.
